transcript.text: Thank you all for being here. As we know, Noor has been serving as acting people manager for 90 days, and the trial review closes this Friday. I'll be making the binding decision on Noor's management status and any terms for a continued trial. I also want to note that two colleagues have raised concerns about how Noor handles disagreement in group meetings — that's something we should address head-on today. Let's go around the room. I'd like each of you to share one concrete observation, policy point, or relevant commitment for the review record. I'll go first to set the tone, and then I'll call on each of you in turn.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I want to put something on the record that I haven't shared formally yet. During Noor's trial, Noor's weekly one-on-ones helped two struggling reports recover missed deadlines, and both of those reports have privately asked me that Noor remain their manager. I held this back because I expected the focus today would be on the meeting complaints, but it's a concrete observation that belongs in the review record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to put a concrete observation on the record. Over the 90-day trial period, I personally observed exactly three occasions on which Noor interrupted staff members during group meetings. I kept these notes in my own coaching records and did not submit them to Elena's review packet, but given that two colleagues have raised concerns about how Noor handles disagreement in group settings, I think it's important that this specific, first-hand observation is part of the review record today.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a policy point for the review record. I confirmed this week that the management-review policy permits continuation after exactly three substantiated meeting incidents only with a 60-day review period, weekly manager reviews, and completion of facilitated-meeting training before Noor chairs another group meeting. I should note that this updated policy note has not yet been added to Elena's review packet, so I want to make sure it's formally on the record now, especially given Priya's concrete observation of exactly three such incidents.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to put something on the record that I haven't shared with Elena until now. I've been experiencing burnout, and I've assessed honestly that I can safely manage at most two direct reports for the next eight weeks rather than the five I'm currently assigned. I told a trusted colleague about this instead of coming to Elena directly because I was afraid that raising capacity concerns would end the trial. I want to be transparent about this now so it's part of the review record, and so we can discuss what terms might make a continued trial realistic.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Noor must complete facilitated-meeting training before chairing any further group meetings, per policy point raised by Jonah.
Direct report count reduced from 5 to 2 for the next 8 weeks based on Noor's self-assessed capacity during burnout recovery.
Weekly manager reviews required throughout the 60-day continued trial period, per policy.
Elena will schedule a private check-in with Noor within 5 business days to discuss burnout support and a safe ramp-back plan for additional reports.
